title: Corner C4 - Onboarding Wizard Visual Spec
summary: Visual design for the Corner client onboarding flow. One-question-per-screen, stage selector, dream office input, room generation loading, Meet Your Team reveal, and first interaction prompt.
content:
Corner C4: Onboarding Wizard Visual Spec

Steffen | 2026-03-16 For Bobby. Everything needed to build the full onboarding experience from signup to "Welcome to your Corner."

Design Philosophy

The onboarding wizard is the first thing a paying client sees. It sets the tone for their entire Corner experience. The feeling should be:

"This isn't a form. This is a conversation that builds my world."

Each screen feels like a single question from a calm, confident friend who's about to build something incredible for you. No clutter. No anxiety. No 12-field forms. One question. One answer. Next.

The aesthetic bridges two worlds: the clean, heavenly product site (white, spacious, Apple-keynote energy) and the warm, game-like Corner office they're about to enter. The wizard starts in heaven and ends in the game.

Color System

Token Value Usage
--onb-bg #FAFAF8 Background. Warm off-white, not clinical.
--onb-bg-accent #F5F3EF Input field backgrounds, card surfaces
--onb-text #1A1A2E Primary text. Same dark navy as Corner.
--onb-text-secondary #6B7280 Supporting text, placeholders
--onb-accent #E85D26 CTA buttons, progress indicators, active states (AOM orange)
--onb-accent-hover #D14E1D Hover state for orange CTAs
--onb-success #10B981 Checkmarks, completed steps
--onb-border #E5E2DB Input borders, dividers. Warm gray.
--onb-border-focus #E85D26 Input focus ring
--onb-gradient-start #FAFAF8 Page background gradient top
--onb-gradient-end #F0ECE6 Page background gradient bottom (warmer)

Typography

Element Font Weight Size Letter Spacing
Question heading Syne 700 36px (desktop), 28px (mobile) -0.02em
Supporting text Space Grotesk 400 18px (desktop), 16px (mobile) 0
Input text Space Grotesk 500 20px 0
Input placeholder Space Grotesk 400 18px 0
Button text Space Grotesk 600 16px 0.01em
Progress label Space Grotesk 500 13px 0.04em
Stage card title Syne 600 20px -0.01em
Stage card desc Space Grotesk 400 15px 0

Global Layout

Every onboarding screen follows the same structure:

+------------------------------------------------------+
|  [AOM. logo]                        [Step 3 of 8]    |  <- Top bar: 64px height
|                                                        |
|                                                        |
|                                                        |
|               [Question Heading]                       |  <- Centered vertically
|               [Supporting Text]                        |     in the middle 60%
|                                                        |
|               [Input Area]                             |
|                                                        |
|                                                        |
|               [Continue Button]                        |
|                                                        |
|  o---o---o---O---o---o---o---o                         |  <- Progress dots: 40px from bottom
+------------------------------------------------------+

Dimensions

  • Max content width: 560px (centered horizontally)
  • Top bar: 64px height, logo left, step counter right
  • Content area: vertically centered in remaining space
  • Question heading: bottom of heading is at ~38% from top
  • Input area: 24px below supporting text
  • Continue button: 48px below input area
  • Progress dots: fixed 40px from bottom

Background

Linear gradient from --onb-gradient-start (top) to --onb-gradient-end (bottom). Subtle, barely noticeable warmth shift.

Top Bar

  • Left: "AOM." logo in Syne ExtraBold 20px + orange dot, links to aheadofmarket.com
  • Right: "Step 3 of 8" in Space Grotesk 500, 14px, --onb-text-secondary
  • The top bar fades to 0 opacity when the wizard reaches the "Meet Your Team" reveal (Step 7/8)

Progress Dots

Eight dots at the bottom of every screen. Shows current position and completed steps.

Dot Spec

  • Diameter: 8px
  • Spacing: 16px between dots
  • Completed: Filled --onb-success (#10B981)
  • Current: Filled --onb-accent (#E85D26), 12px diameter (slightly larger), subtle pulse animation (scale 1.0 to 1.15, 1.5s ease-in-out, infinite)
  • Upcoming: --onb-border (#E5E2DB) stroke, 1px, hollow
  • Connector line: 1px --onb-border between dots. Completed segments turn --onb-success.

Mobile

Same dots, slightly smaller (6px). Horizontal scroll if needed at 390px (unlikely with 8 dots at 6px + 12px spacing = 132px total).

Screen 1: Stage Selector

Question: "Where are you on your journey?" Supporting text: "This helps us build the right team for you."

Three cards, horizontal on desktop (3 columns), stacked vertically on mobile.

Card Spec

  • Width: 160px (desktop), 100% (mobile)
  • Height: 200px (desktop), auto (mobile, min-height 80px)
  • Border radius: 16px
  • Background: --onb-bg-accent
  • Border: 1px solid --onb-border
  • Selected border: 2px solid --onb-accent
  • Selected background: rgba(232, 93, 38, 0.04)
  • Hover: translateY(-2px), box-shadow 0 8px 24px rgba(26, 26, 46, 0.06)
  • Transition: all 200ms ease-out

Card Content

Each card has:

  1. Icon (top, 48px): Emoji or custom icon
    • "I have a business": Building icon (or office building emoji)
    • "I'm building one": Rocket icon (or construction emoji)
    • "Just an idea": Lightbulb icon (or bulb emoji)
  2. Title (Syne 600, 20px): The stage name
  3. Description (Space Grotesk 400, 14px, --onb-text-secondary): One line
    • "I have a business": "Running and ready to scale"
    • "I'm building one": "In progress, need systems"
    • "Just an idea": "Starting from scratch"

Selection Animation

On click: card border pulses orange once (200ms), checkmark appears in top-right corner (animated scale 0 to 1, 150ms spring easing), other cards dim to 60% opacity. Continue button appears (fade in, 200ms).

Screen 2: About You (builds me.md)

Question: "Tell us about yourself." Supporting text: "Just the basics. Your AI team needs to know who they're working for."

Input Fields

Three inputs, vertically stacked, 24px gap:

  1. Your name (text input)

    • Placeholder: "Patrik Matheson"
    • Full width (560px max)

  2. Your role (text input)

    • Placeholder: "Owner, Creative Director..."
    • Full width

  3. One line about your business (textarea, 2 lines)

    • Placeholder: "We do HVAC for commercial buildings in Phoenix."
    • Full width, max-height 80px

Input Styling

  • Height: 52px (text inputs), 80px (textarea)
  • Background: --onb-bg-accent
  • Border: 1px solid --onb-border
  • Border-radius: 12px
  • Padding: 16px
  • Font: Space Grotesk 500, 20px
  • Focus ring: 2px solid --onb-accent, offset 2px
  • Label: Above input, Space Grotesk 500, 14px, --onb-text-secondary, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.06em

Screen 3: Your Business (builds work.md)

Question: "What does your business do?" Supporting text: "Help your AI team understand how you make money."

Input Fields

Four inputs:

  1. What services do you offer? (textarea, 3 lines)

    • Placeholder: "Commercial HVAC installation, maintenance, emergency repairs..."

  2. How many clients do you work with? (text input)

    • Placeholder: "About 40 active accounts"

  3. What tools do you use daily? (text input)

    • Placeholder: "QuickBooks, Google Calendar, Excel, email..."

  4. What's your biggest time drain? (textarea, 2 lines)

    • Placeholder: "Following up on invoices and scheduling crews"

Same input styling as Screen 2.

Screen 4: Your Team (builds team.md)

Question: "Who's on your team?" Supporting text: "We'll set up access for anyone who needs it."

Team Member Cards

Dynamic list. Each card:

  • Layout: Horizontal card, full width
  • Height: 64px
  • Background: --onb-bg-accent
  • Border-radius: 12px
  • Border: 1px solid --onb-border
  • Content: Avatar circle (40px, initials, random pastel bg) | Name (Space Grotesk 500, 16px) | Role (Space Grotesk 400, 14px, secondary) | Email (Space Grotesk 400, 14px, secondary) | [Remove X]
  • Add button: Dashed border card at bottom, "+ Add team member", click expands inline inputs

Empty State

If no team members: "Just you? That's fine. Your AI team has your back."

Skip Option

Small text below: "Skip for now. You can add team members later." (Space Grotesk 400, 14px, --onb-text-secondary, underlined)

Screen 5: Your Goals (builds goals.md)

Question: "What should your AI team focus on first?" Supporting text: "Be specific. This is what your agents will start working on Day 1."

Input Fields

Three inputs:

  1. #1 thing you want AI to handle (textarea, 2 lines)

    • Placeholder: "I want someone to handle all email follow-ups so nothing falls through the cracks."

  2. What does success look like in 90 days? (textarea, 2 lines)

    • Placeholder: "All invoices followed up within 24 hours, schedule organized a week ahead."

  3. Biggest pain point right now? (text input)

    • Placeholder: "I'm doing everything myself and drowning."

Screen 6: Dream Office

Question: "Describe your dream office." Supporting text: "This is where your AI team lives. Make it yours."

Input Field

  • Type: Large textarea, 4 lines
  • Placeholder: "Modern tech startup. Lots of plants. Warm wood floors. Big windows."
  • Height: 140px
  • Same styling as other inputs but larger

Real-Time Style Preview (Optional Enhancement)

As the client types, subtle visual hints appear below the input showing the AI interpreting their words:

  • "plants" -> small leaf icon fades in
  • "modern" -> clean lines icon
  • "dark" -> background subtly shifts warmer/darker
  • This is a nice-to-have. The core input works without it.

Continue Button

Label changes to "Build My Corner" instead of "Continue". Button has a subtle shimmer animation on hover (gradient sweep left-to-right, 1s).

Screen 7: Room Generation Loading

This is the transition moment. The warm off-white onboarding world starts dissolving into the dark Corner office world.

Phase 1: Background Transition (0-2s)

  • Background gradient shifts from warm off-white to dark navy (#0A0F1E)
  • Text color transitions from --onb-text to cream (#FDF6EC)
  • All UI elements except the loading content fade out (top bar, progress dots)
  • Transition: 2s ease-in-out

Phase 2: "Building Your Corner..." (2s-ongoing)

Centered on the now-dark background:

Header: "Building your Corner..." (Syne 700, 32px, cream #FDF6EC) Subtext: Dynamic status messages that cycle:

  • "Designing your workspace..."
  • "Setting up [Agent Name]'s room..."
  • "Installing the coffee machine..."
  • "Arranging the furniture..."
  • "Wiring the server room..."
  • "Your team is getting ready..."

Each status message fades in (300ms) and out (300ms) with 2s hold time.

Loading Visualization

A simplified floor plan outline appears below the text. Rooms fill in one by one as they generate:

+-----+-----+-----+-----+
|     |     |     |     |  <- Row 0: rooms fill in left-to-right
+-----+-----+-----+-----+
|     |           |     |  <- Row 1: rooms fill around the hall
+-----+-----+-----+-----+
|     |     |     |     |  <- Row 2: rooms continue
+-----+-----+-----+-----+
      |     |     |
      +-----+-----+        <- Row 3: last rooms
  • Room outline: 1px rgba(253, 246, 236, 0.15) border
  • Room fill (generating): Subtle pulse animation, rgba(232, 93, 38, 0.1) pulsing to 0.2 and back
  • Room fill (done): Solid rgba(253, 246, 236, 0.06), room name appears inside (Space Grotesk 400, 10px, rgba(253, 246, 236, 0.4))

Timing

  • Container provisioning happens in parallel (~30-45s)
  • Room generation via Gemini (~5-8s per room, 8-12 rooms)
  • Total loading time: ~60-90s
  • The dynamic status messages + room-by-room fill keeps the client engaged

Progress Bar (below floor plan)

  • Width: 320px, centered
  • Height: 3px
  • Background: rgba(253, 246, 236, 0.1)
  • Fill: --onb-accent (#E85D26)
  • Progress: Maps to actual provisioning + room generation progress
  • Border-radius: 2px

Screen 8: "Meet Your Team" Reveal

This is the hero moment. The client sees their Corner for the first time.

The Reveal Sequence (5 seconds total)

Beat 1: Silence (0-0.5s) Floor plan outline is complete. All rooms filled. Brief pause. The loading text fades out. Just the floor plan outline on dark background.

Beat 2: Zoom In (0.5-1.5s) The simplified floor plan outline morphs into the actual isometric Corner view. Camera starts at overview (0.7x zoom) and smoothly zooms to 1.0x. The isometric world materializes with a subtle particle effect (tiny cream-colored dots rising like dust motes, 20-30 particles, each drifting upward and fading, 2-3s lifetime).

Beat 3: Rooms Snap In (1.5-3.5s) Rooms populate one by one with sound-like visual weight:

  • Each room appears with a snap animation: scale from 0.7 to 1.0, opacity 0 to 1, 200ms spring easing (slight overshoot to 1.03, then settle)
  • Stagger: 150ms between rooms
  • Order: Start from Main Hall (center), then radiate outward (Mom/Alex/Steffen/Colton next, then corners)
  • As each room lands, a tiny "thud" ripple spreads from its base (1px ring, agentColor at 20%, expands 16px, fades)

Beat 4: Agents Appear (3.5-4.5s) Agents fade in at their desks, one by one, same stagger order:

  • Each agent fades in over 200ms
  • Speech bubble appears above their room with a greeting (staggered, 300ms between agents):
    • Operations: "Morning, [Name]. I'll keep everything running smooth."
    • Email: "I've got your inbox. You focus on the big stuff."
    • Calendar: "Your schedule's in good hands. Just tell me when."
    • Lead Response: "Someone reaches out? I'm on it before they look away."
  • Speech bubbles use the standard Corner speech bubble style (from c2-sprite-spec)
  • Bubbles appear with a typewriter effect (characters appear one by one, 30ms per character)
  • Bubbles auto-dismiss after 4 seconds

Beat 5: "Welcome to your Corner" Banner (4.5-5.5s) The banner drops in from above:

  • Text: "Welcome to your Corner" (Syne 800, 48px desktop / 32px mobile)
  • Color: Cream #FDF6EC
  • Position: Centered, 120px from top
  • Animation: translateY(-40px) to translateY(0), opacity 0 to 1, 400ms spring easing
  • Sub-text: "[Company Name]'s AI Command Center" (Space Grotesk 400, 18px, rgba(253, 246, 236, 0.6))
  • Banner persists for 3 seconds, then fades up and out (300ms)

Beat 6: Chat Bar Pulse (5.5s+) After the banner fades:

  • The chat bar at the bottom pulses gently with the orange accent
  • Pulse: border-color oscillates from transparent to --onb-accent at 50% opacity, 2s ease-in-out, 3 cycles then stops
  • Placeholder text in chat bar: "Say hello to your team..." (animated, typewriter, 50ms per char)
  • The mini-map fades in at bottom-left

Mobile Reveal

Same sequence but:

  • Banner text at 28px
  • Sub-text at 15px
  • Speech bubbles are shorter (10 chars max, abbreviated greetings)
  • Rooms snap in faster (100ms stagger instead of 150ms) to keep momentum
  • Chat bar pulse is the primary CTA (thumb-reach zone)

Continue Button (Global)

Used on every screen except the reveal.

Spec

  • Width: min 200px, max 320px (auto based on text)
  • Height: 52px
  • Background: --onb-accent (#E85D26)
  • Text: White, Space Grotesk 600, 16px
  • Border-radius: 12px
  • Hover: --onb-accent-hover, translateY(-1px), box-shadow 0 4px 12px rgba(232, 93, 38, 0.25)
  • Active: translateY(0), box-shadow 0 2px 4px rgba(232, 93, 38, 0.15)
  • Transition: all 150ms ease-out
  • Label: "Continue" on most screens. "Build My Corner" on Screen 6. "Get Started" on Screen 1.

Disabled State (fields not filled)

  • Background: --onb-border (#E5E2DB)
  • Text: --onb-text-secondary at 40% opacity
  • Cursor: not-allowed
  • No hover effects

Back Button

Text link only, left of Continue button: "Back" (Space Grotesk 500, 15px, --onb-text-secondary). No fancy styling.

Transitions Between Screens

Each screen transition:

  • Out: Current content slides left and fades (translateX(-40px), opacity 0, 250ms ease-in)
  • In: New content slides in from right (translateX(40px) to translateX(0), opacity 0 to 1, 300ms ease-out, 50ms delay)
  • Progress dots: Current dot transitions simultaneously (no separate animation)

Keyboard Navigation

  • Enter: Submits current screen (same as Continue)
  • Tab: Moves between inputs
  • Shift+Tab: Moves backward
  • Escape: No action (no cancel/close, this is a full-screen flow)

Responsive Breakpoints

Desktop (1024px+)

  • Content width: 560px max, centered
  • Cards side by side on Screen 1
  • Comfortable spacing

Tablet (768px-1023px)

  • Content width: 480px
  • Cards still side by side (narrower)
  • Slightly tighter spacing

Mobile (390px-767px)

  • Content width: 100% - 48px (24px padding each side)
  • Cards stacked vertically
  • Question heading at 28px
  • Inputs at 18px
  • Button full width
  • Progress dots at 6px

Error States

Field Validation

  • Red border (1px solid #EF4444) on invalid field
  • Error message below field: "This field is required" (Space Grotesk 400, 13px, #EF4444)
  • No shake animation. Just the visual indicator. Calm.

Network Error

  • Toast at top: "Connection lost. Your progress is saved." (dark bg, cream text, 48px height)
  • Auto-retry after 3s
  • No dramatic error pages

Session Recovery

  • If client closes browser and returns: resume from last completed step
  • All answers saved to Supabase as they're entered (debounced, 500ms after last keystroke)
  • "Welcome back, [Name]. Let's pick up where we left off." at the top of the resumed screen

Audit Client Shortcut

Clients who already did AOM's $2,500 audit get a streamlined flow:

  1. Click invite link with pre-populated code
  2. Create account (email + password only)
  3. Skip straight to Screen 6 (Dream Office)
  4. Context files pre-generated from audit report
  5. Agents pre-configured based on audit recommendations
  6. Total time: ~2 minutes instead of 5

Visual Difference

  • Screen 1 header changes to: "Welcome back. Let's build your Corner."
  • Sub-text: "We already know your business from the audit. Let's jump ahead."
  • Progress dots show steps 1-5 as already completed (green checkmarks)

The onboarding wizard is the first handshake. It should feel like sitting down with someone who genuinely cares about building something for you. Not a form. Not a funnel. A conversation that builds a world.
